note: workspace_key = sha256(str(Path(p).resolve()))[:12]. These entries hash the literal string, bypassing resolve(), so the expectation is machine-independent; the Windows sample is the one a port is most likely to get wrong. Note that the real function resolves first, so on a machine where the workspace path contains a symlink the input is the canonical path, not the one the user typed.

layout.legacy_fallback: <workspace>/.yucode when it exists and the home dir does not
